import org.jetbrains.uast.UClass

    override fun getApplicableUastTypes(): List<Class<out UElement>> = listOf(UMethod::class.java)

    override fun createUastHandler(context: JavaContext): UElementHandler = object : UElementHandler() {
        override fun visitMethod(node: UMethod) {
            if (node.isConstructor) return
            val methodName = node.name ?: return
            val containingClass = node.containingClass ?: return
            val className = containingClass.name ?: return

                "Method `$methodName` has the same name as its containing class, so it is not a constructor"
            )
        }
    }

    companion object {
        val ISSUE = Issue.create(
            id = "NotConstructor",
            briefDescription = "Not a constructor",
            explanation = "A method with the same name as its containing class and a return type is not a constructor. Constructors have no return type. This usually indicates a typo or a missing constructor declaration.",

            priority = 4,
            severity = Severity.WARNING,
            implementation = Implementation(
                WrongConstructorDetector::class.java,
                Scope.JAVA_FILE_SCOPE
            )
        )
    }
}

```kt
import com.android.tools.lint.client.api.UElementHandler

import com.intellij.psi.PsiModifier
import org.jetbrains.uast.UElement
import org.jetbrains.uast.UMethod

class WrongConstructorDetector : Detector(), SourceCodeScanner {

        listOf(UMethod::class.java)

            override fun visitMethod(node: UMethod) {
                if (node.isConstructor) {

                val className = containingClass.name ?: return

                    return

                    node,
                    context.getLocation(node.nameIdentifier ?: node),
                    "Method `$methodName` has the same name as its containing class, " +
                            "so it is not a constructor"
                )
            }
        }

    companion object {
        @JvmField

            id = "NotConstructor",
            briefDescription = "Not a constructor",
            explanation = """

            priority = 4,
            severity = Severity.WARNING,
            implementation = Implementation(
                WrongConstructorDetector::class.java,
                Scope.JAVA_FILE_SCOPE
            )
        )
    }
}
```
